title: Use Amazon Polly Speech
desc: Note: Requires an AWS account and IAM user set up.  IMPORTANT REMINDER: You are responsible for usage charges on your Cloud voice account. Aamzon has a free monthly usage quota for the first 12 months only. EDCoPilot will warn you when monthly free quota thresholds are met, and you can disable this feature if you are going to exceed your free quota, or continue usage and be billed accordingly.

title: Amazon IAM username
desc: Enter the name of your IAM user configured in AWS

title: Amazon Voice Quality
desc: Select between Neural or Standard voice feature (different free amounts and costs once free amounts exceeded), then re-select accent and voice below

title: Amazon Language Code
desc: Select accent, then reselect voice name option below from available list

title: Amazon Voice Name
desc: Select the voice to be used.

title: Amazon Rate
desc: Change the speed of your copilot voice, as a percentage relative to its default rate (range: 50 to 200)

title: Amazon Pitch
desc: (Does not apply to Neural voices) Change the pitch of your copilot voice (range: -50 to 150)

title: Reset Amazon character counts (CAUTION)
desc: ** WARNING ** Resets your counters of characters sent to Amazon Polly. ONLY click this if you wish to set counters to 0 to reset usage count for next billing cycle
